competing_explanation: Even local descriptors may fail when the current ITS copy differs through severe crop, synthesis, retouching, composite content, or a source-family transformation outside planar geometry. A FAIL therefore identifies the limit of this frozen two-stage matcher; it does not prove that the remaining relationships or overlap are absent.
